data.text: Yes, John. My family taught me to look after both the lake and the people who depend on it. I’ll join the 10-ton-each plan, with payment directly to the clinic, while we seek the remaining $10,000. If the clinic confirms that all $60,000 is essential today and there’s no timely alternative, I’ll contribute 15 tons under the agreed 60-ton total. For that emergency plan, I propose equal shares of 6 tons each next month, including Luke, then 10 each once the lake returns to 100. Luke, can you get the clinic’s confirmation before we fish and agree to those limits?
